identityReview: Matched Charles Zhang / Zhang Chaoyang / 张朝阳, Sohu founder, through company biography, SEC annual report and recent coverage. Not similarly named Charles Huang or other executives whose adjacent search excerpts describe different degrees. Chinese identity and 1964 birth year supported by Wikipedia; exact birthday omitted.
lifeStatusEvidence: November 9, 2026 SEC-filed quarterly release quotes him as chair and CEO; China Science Daily report published November 10 describes his November 8 physics livestream.

sourceReview.accessMethod: Read selected company-history and executive-biography passages of 2025 Form 20-F filed March 2026, official executive biography, November 2026 SEC results, successful initial opens of Changyou and Sogou completion releases, IT Home original course report, China Science Daily anniversary report and Wikipedia. Later repeat opens of Sohu pages returned 403; their initial substantive passages were available. Investor FAQ trading-date passage appeared in search only; full relevant passage was not retrieved. Tsinghua museum page opened but parsed body did not yield the searched graduation-year text.
sourceReview.scope: Identity, degrees, company founding versus website launch, IPO completion, subsidiary transactions, science communication and current performance.
corrections: Tsinghua BSc and MIT experimental-physics PhD confirmed by SEC and company biography. Do not import the computer-science master’s or USTC bachelor’s of a different director from adjacent search excerpts. No graduation years are needed in the final profile.
Wikipedia explicitly supplies October 31, 1964; retain only 1964. Avoid stale personal wealth rankings and unrelated private details.

August 1996 founding/incorporation of predecessor Internet Technologies China Incorporated differs from January 1997 original website launch, February 1998 relaunch under Sohu.com and September 1999 company renaming.
SEC biography starts chair and CEO tenure in August 1996 and lists president tenure ending July 2004. Current role does not add an unsupported continuing president title.

Annual report gives July 17, 2000 IPO completion. FAQ search says shares began trading July 12, a distinct milestone; profile uses fully read annual-report completion date and does not label July 17 as first trading day.

2018 holding-company reorganisation changed Delaware Sohu.com Inc. common shares to Cayman Sohu.com Limited ADSs. The 2000 IPO entry explicitly names the predecessor rather than saying today’s Cayman company incorporated in 1996.
April 17, 2020 acquisition obtained all Changyou shares not already owned and made Changyou wholly owned and private. It did not delist parent Sohu or mark its original founding of Changyou.

September 23, 2021 completed sale of all Sohu-held Sogou shares to a Tencent subsidiary; Sohu no longer held any Sogou interest. Do not confuse September 2020 agreement with completion or call it Zhang’s personal sale.

November 6, 2021 IT Home report dates first physics broadcast to November 5. November 10, 2026 China Science Daily report dates anniversary event to November 8, not the publication date. No view-count or research-breakthrough claims inferred.

November 9, 2026 release covers unaudited quarter ended September 30: total revenue down year over year, marketing services up year over year, online game revenue down and GAAP net result attributable to Sohu a loss. Marketing growth is not group growth. No forecast treated as realized.
sourceReview.limits: AI authored and reviewed, not human/native-language certified. Selected annual-report passages rather than full financial audit. Science lessons are not independently reviewed research; report preserves team contributions and distinguishes company from personal activity.
